name: Sakya Tashi Choeling, Budapest
reason: Old hand-built site (sakya.hu). The home page promotes initiations with claims against cancer, illness, black magic and bad astrology, and the only upcoming dated event is a Medicine Buddha (healing) initiation on 26 Nov - both out under the health rule. The teachings pages are reproduced texts by other Sakya masters, not the centre's own, the photos of its temple sit on another host (sakyamedia.jugiter.net), and its YouTube has one 2017 video. Too little that can be listed cleanly. Email sakyahungary@gmail.com was visible if the owner wants to revisit.
